title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يلقي كلمة ضيوف ملتقى النور الأول للقرآن وأهله بالجزائر
title_en: The Sheikh Delivers the Guests' Address at the First al-Nur Forum for the Qur'an and Its People in Algeria
body_ar: حل فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو حفظه الله تعالى رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا يوم الأحد ضيفا على وزارة الشؤون الدينية والأوقاف بالجزائر للمشاركة في ملتقى النور الأول للقرآن وأهله الذي تنظمه مديرية الشؤون الدينية والأوقاف لولاية الجزائر أيام 24 و 25 و 26 جمادى الثانية الموافق 14 و 15 و 16 إبريل ويتناول الملتقى موضوع :المناهج والدراسات الحديثة في تحفيظ وتعليم القرآن الكريم . وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ ـ اليوم الثلاثاء 14 ابريل 2015م ـ كلمة الضيوف في افتتاح الملتقى كما تم تكريمه في الحفل نفسه من طرف وزير الشؤون الدينية ووالي ولاية الجزائر العاصمة . وستكون للشيخ مشاركات في بقية أيام الملتقى منها كلمة بعنوان : تعليم القرآن الكريم دراسة تأصيلية مساء الثلاثاء هذا بالإضافة إلى محاضرة يوم غد الأربعاء بعنوان : القراءة الجماعية للقرآن الكريم دراسة تأصيلية. من جهة ثانية أعدت الوزارة برنامجا في مساجد العاصمة الجزائر يتمثل في محاضرة كل يوم بعد صلاة المغرب من الاثنين إلى الخميس بدأها مساء أمس بمحاضرة عن طلب العلم في مسجد الجهاد الأكبر وسيختم برنامج المساجد بدرس الجمعة يقدمه الشيخ قبل صلاة الجمعة في مسجد أبي ذر الغفاري.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew (may God the Exalted preserve him), head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, arrived on Sunday as a guest of the Ministry of Religious Affairs and Endowments in Algeria, to take part in the first al-Nur Forum for the Qur'an and Its People, organised by the Directorate of Religious Affairs and Endowments for the wilaya of Algiers on 24, 25 and 26 Jumada al-Thaniyah, corresponding to 14, 15 and 16 April. The forum treats the subject of 'Modern Methods and Studies in the Memorisation and Teaching of the Noble Qur'an'.

His Eminence delivered today, Tuesday 14 April 2015, the guests' address at the opening of the forum, and was honoured at the same ceremony by the Minister of Religious Affairs and by the wali of the wilaya of Algiers.

The Sheikh will make contributions on the remaining days of the forum, among them an address entitled 'The Teaching of the Noble Qur'an: A Study of Its Rooting in the Sources', on Tuesday evening; in addition to a lecture tomorrow, Wednesday, entitled 'Group Recitation of the Noble Qur'an: A Study of Its Rooting in the Sources'.

Separately, the Ministry has prepared a programme in the mosques of the capital, Algiers, consisting of a lecture each day after the sunset prayer from Monday to Thursday, which he began yesterday evening with a lecture on seeking knowledge at the Jihad al-Akbar Mosque. The mosque programme will conclude with the Friday lesson the Sheikh will give before the Friday prayer at the Abu Dharr al-Ghifari Mosque.

flags.context: the subtitle of two of the Sheikh's addresses
options: a study of its rooting in the sources
flags.note: تأصيل is the operation of tracing a practice back to its basis in the sources, so that the question is not whether group recitation works but whether it has a warrant. 'A foundational study' is shorter but loses that; the fuller rendering is used because in both titles the point of the exercise is precisely the rooting. Not in the project glossary; a candidate for addition.

flags.context: the title of the Wednesday lecture
options: group recitation of the Noble Qur'an
flags.note: The practice is reciting aloud in unison, common in North and West African Qur'an schools and disputed among jurists. The record gives only the title, so the Sheikh's position on it is not recoverable here.

options: the first al-Nur Forum for the Qur'an and Its People
the first Light Forum for the Qur'an and its bearers
flags.note: أهل القرآن, 'the people of the Qur'an', is the traditional designation for those who memorise, recite and teach it, drawn from the report 'the people of the Qur'an are the people of God and His elect'. Kept literal; 'its bearers' would be clearer to an English reader but is not what the name says.

translator_notes: A programme notice. None of the addresses or lectures is reported, only their titles.
ولاية is kept as 'wilaya' and والي as 'wali', the Algerian administrative terms, which have no exact English equivalents.
The Hijri and Gregorian dates given for the forum, 24–26 Jumada al-Thaniyah and 14–16 April 2015, agree.
